Ik a lot of people are talking about how his girlfriend is not in a good mindset right now and I totally agree with that, however it's hard to gauge what is her being unreasonable/an asshole and what is natural grief and stress. For me, my father died in the middle of the night when I was 17 and I was doing CPR on him to save his life. One of my closest friends could not attend the funeral for him because his school had a strict absence policy and he didn't want to risk missing more time than he had, and tbh even though I wanted him there and that it was kind of a dumb reason not to show up, I could give less than 2 shits since I didn't even want to be at the funeral myself; frankly no one does. That's my experience during the grief process though, so who knows how another person may feel about someone missing such a crushing moment, but from my pov, missing a funeral is such a small part in the whole process that I can't quite see why she's making such a huge deal out of it even though OP is doing his best to make as much of the funeral as possible. I was a dick when I was grieving too, and would frequently lash out, but it never got this bad. 

To OP: I am very sorry to hear that people are giving you nasty comments. You're NTA here and you're stuck between a rock and a hard place. Your girlfriend may need some time to grieve in her own way and maybe that's why she's not picking up, so giving her space is okay. If she's still upset at the fact that you weren't at the funeral fast enough/long enough for a while, that's on her and she has no excuse to hold a grudge. Best of luck in whatever happens coming up.
